mechanism: Darunavir is a protease inhibitor that may impair renal function and increase potassium retention, particularly in patients with underlying kidney disease or when combined with other nephrotoxic agents or ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically in patients receiving darunavir, especially those with renal impairment, diabetes, or concurrent use of potassium-elevating medications; avoid potassium supplementation unless clinically indicated with documented hypokalemia.
